collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — DREAMS AND AMBITIONS (DRM-01..50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Big dreams, small dreams, secret dreams and silly ones: things villagers hope for, work toward, give up on, change their minds about, or simply enjoy imagining. Ambition is optional, and a dream that never comes true is not a sad ending.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. Edit anything and send it back; nothing ships until you approve.

collection.description: A villager content on their own quietly dreams of raising a child someday, and a friend sits down: tell them, or keep it close.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) isn't with anyone, and is content that way. But lately (subject.he/she) has been watching the children play on the beach, and thinking that someday (subject.he/she) would like to raise a child. Maybe (subject.his/her) own, maybe one who needs a home. (subject.He/she) doesn't know how, or when, or with whom, or whether alone. (subject.He/she) hasn't told anyone. (friend) sits down beside (subject.him/her).

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: (subject) says it out loud for the first time. (friend) doesn't laugh or ask "but who with?" (friend.He/she) just says, "You'd be good at it." (subject) isn't sure about that. But it's nice to have said it, and to have it be a real thing now, and not just a thought (subject.he/she) carries around by (subject.him/her)self.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: (subject) doesn't say anything. They watch the children in comfortable silence. (child), one of them, runs over to show (subject) a shell, and (subject.he/she) admires it properly. It's (subject.his/her) dream. It doesn't have to be anyone else's business yet, or ever. There's plenty of time, and also, (subject) thinks, there is no hurry at all.
